newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 91-day T-bills yield 7.394 percent at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 91-day T-bills yield 7.394 percent at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 91-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 7.394 percent versus 7.237 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 182-day treasury bills was 7.432 percent versus 7.230 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender. Bids totalled NZ$345 million.
The weighted average yield for NZ$50 million of 399-day treasury bills was 7.526 percent versus 7.404 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender. Bids totalled NZ$216 million.
